selection_rule: Use the largest corrected regular absolute-trace fiber in the independent p941 census field; the pre-run census identifies |t|=18 with 112 points.
point_order: sorted by integer affine coordinates (x,y) from the corrected ledger
hecke_row_policy: For each source and degree, retain polynomial coefficients, factor degrees, rational-root count and status. Accept a row only for a uniquely reconstructed complete rational neighbor multiset wholly inside the frozen fiber, after Hecke group-sum and finite-j modular-polynomial checks. Preserve all failed source statuses.
direct_control: Exhaust all distinct support-1, support-2 and support-3 signed group-law relations with first coefficient +1 and other signs in order [-1,+1]. Verify every accepted relation on the curve.
